requirements.evidence: Core contract is present: `database/migrations/2026_10_29_051007_create_entities_table.php:16-19` (slug `entities_slug_unique`, soft deletes), `database/migrations/2026_10_29_051008_create_entity_memberships_table.php:16-22` (cascading FKs, role default, both unique indexes and generated `owner_seq`), `app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-39`, `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-38`, the three `app/Livewire/Entity/*` components and `routes/web.php:53-67`. Gaps: `app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:61-75` lets `assignRole` change the owner's role (breaking the one-owner invariant), and role labels are not translated (`resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:33-37`).

conventions.evidence: Most project conventions are respected: generated-style migrations with a reversible `down()`, deliberate `$fillable` (`app/Models/Entity.php:18`), factories, policies, docs and CHANGELOG updated. However, domain writes bypass the required `app/Actions/*` layer (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:35-105`, `app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:36-115`), and Livewire validation ignores the project's `#[Validate]` + `$this->validate()` pattern (`Settings.php:22-26,40-43`; `Members.php:68-71`).

security.evidence: Every mount and action calls `$this->authorize(...)` (`app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:20-23`; `Members.php:31,37,66,86`; `Settings.php:30,38,51,55,71,75`), the bound entity is `#[Locked]` (`Settings.php:19-20`), action parameters are resolved through `$this->entity->memberships()->...` (`Members.php:64,84`; `Settings.php:77`), and Blade output is escaped with `{{ }}` throughout. The remaining weakness is that `assignRole` can demote the owner (`Members.php:61-75`), plus no `#[Validate]` on `targetMembershipId` (`Settings.php:26`).

tests.evidence: No test files appear in `change.diff` (23 changed files, none under `tests/`), so there is no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for the policies, the pick endpoint, the generated-column invariant or any Livewire action.

simplicity.evidence: Focused components/factories and reuse of the existing `layouts::default-page`, lang files and Bulma classes keep the change small. Minor duplication remains in `Settings::delete()`/`transfer()` re-fetching and re-authorizing the same entity (`app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:51-55,71-75`), and the owner branch in `Members.php:88-92` is dead.

readability.evidence: Clear names, short methods and relation/scope PHPDoc (`app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12-76`) make the code easy to follow; leftovers are the unreachable owner guard in `app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:88-92` and hard-coded role labels in `resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:33-37`.

scope.evidence: All 23 files serve the task (migrations, models, enum, policies, factories, Livewire components/views, routes, lang, schema doc, CHANGELOG); documentation edits are limited to the newly implemented tables (`docs/database-schema.md:4`), with no unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The change adds no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all, so the mandatory test-first convention, policy coverage and the required unauthorized-call and tamper tests for every Livewire action are unmet.

`assignRole()` validates only the requested role and can write to the owner's membership, so an admin (or the owner) can demote the owner, leaving the entity with no owner and bypassing the owner-only transfer flow.
Member, settings, delete and ownership-transfer writes are executed directly in the Livewire components rather than through the project's one-class-per-use-case `app/Actions/*` layer.
Public input properties lack `#[Validate]` rules and validation is done inline or through `Validator::make`, diverging from the project's `#[Validate]` + `$this->validate()` Livewire pattern.
The pick endpoint hard-codes the membership check instead of authorizing through `EntityPolicy::view`, duplicating authorization outside the policies layer.
The role column and the admin/employee buttons render hard-coded English values instead of `lang/*/ui.php` keys, contrary to the task's all-screen-text rule.
The explicit owner abort and the `Owner` entry in `$isManager` are unreachable because the policy already denies deleting the owner's membership, adding dead branches.

review.summary: The change implements the entities/entity_memberships schema (including the generated-column one-owner index), the policies, the pick endpoint and the dashboard/members/settings Livewire pages, and largely matches the requested contract. It ships no tests at all and lets an admin demote the owner through assignRole, breaking the one-owner invariant; smaller deviations are writes outside app/Actions, missing #[Validate] properties and unlocalized role labels. Overall the feature needs changes before it can merge.
